author: Machin_Gon2
quote: Not able to do as much as previous GTAs and forced to be with Lucia. Lots of bug issues and the physics of the plane are terrible. Not worth 13 years of waiting.

author: Machin_Gon2
quote: Its a very enjoyable Blockbuster Hack n slash game, great combat, amazing storytelling. Not perfect but doesnt deserve a 0 at all.

author: Machin_Gon2
quote: Its a tower defense with tons of levels and tons of available units, the stories are kinda ok but the gameplay can be really addictive and satisfying. Its super cheap so its a good choice to spend some hours on it.

author: Machin_Gon2
quote: Super addictive action puzzle, its a game that requires some tactical build-up on each run and also a continues farming creation puzzle that will power up you for the next run. Simple and deep, loved it.

author: Machin_Gon2
quote: I didnt like playing RE in a while, too much effort in the 1st person horror for me, awesome games but lack something from the amazing Re4, but Requiem really did it, so much options to play it, so constatnly dynamic, so much action AND horror. Just a masterpiece than make me look back at RE again.

author: Machin_Gon2
quote: DS2 has one of the mpst amazing intros in ways of beautiful landscapes and delightful music, only to be follpwed by management, action, survival and lots of amazing journeys to have. Truly a GOTY contender for 2025.

author: Machin_Gon2
quote: Amazing how revolutionary some slightly proper changes to gameplay can improve the experience in pro of fun and randomness. Truly one of the best MK experiences ever.

author: Machin_Gon2
quote: This game is amazing, i know lots of people already talked about its austonding graphics, excellent performance and great nostalgic value. But i wanna talk about the game mechanics, cause you can feel how the devs love platforming and its deeply infused on how you can pass from float, to punch, to glide in all form of fun ways. And you could say its just as other great platformers, yes, but with its own unique feel that thrives on imagination, skills and fun. Truly amazed to see that not only the great N is capable of do this kinda stuff. An instantly must play.

author: Machin_Gon2
quote: This is an semi-open world adventure/rpg game that simulates to be a Mmorpg. It is divided by medium/larges zones that you access from a hub, like a Platformer game. The gameplay is like a fast action game but with the actions stacked just like in Dark souls, so if you attack, attack and defend the character will do that in that order. It is very colorful and unique in conparison with the Neptunia saga in general. Recommended for Nep fans and newcomers but keep in mind is more like a AA game, so its not like a AAA super budget action game.

author: Machin_Gon2
quote: This is a Neptunia spin-off that reminds me a little to 4 Goddesess online, with the difference that this is a TPS. You got on a linear adventure in 3D levels with some little exploration and in vibrant neppynvironments. The game can get tedious after the 10hr but it just last 12 or 15 if you wanna plat it. Very recommendable for Nep fans, but not so much for anyone who dislikes long texts and anime visuals.

author: Machin_Gon2
quote: This a rythmn game such as Theatherythmn FF. It summarizes the history of all KH games and also gives us a littke extra after the events of Re:Mind, DLC of KH3. Its gameplay is preety good, not so sofisticated, but really enjoyable. A must for every KH fan.

author: Machin_Gon2
quote:
The game is very polemic, but the main reason  is that the people dont like the main history cause its different and it tries something that is not usual in videogames storytelling.
Having this stated the games mechanics are great, an enhanced version of the 1st games mechanics, simply stunning.
The graphics and details are amazing, something not even RDR2 could achieve.
It should be played without spoilers and with open mind and a lot of emphaty, because the history tries to play with that.
A very recommended game.

author: Machin_Gon2
quote: Dreams is 2 things: A very sofisticate software that allows you to create tons of things: music, art, dioramas, and even entire games; and also is a searcher for other people creations, their music, characters and games. Its amazing what Media Molecule achieve with this, its something that you should definitively try.

author: Machin_Gon2
quote: This game is great, very creative, those 0's and 2's of rating are ridicolous, just people trying to give hate to this good game. Its not an usual experience, yes, but nevertheless its interesting and refreshing to the industry.

author: Machin_Gon2
quote:
This game is stunnig, just like the past 2 games (The first one and Golden Abyss are good but not incredible) you will be always at the edge of the coach, great sequences of driving, exploring, shooting all mixed up in a way you wanna continue and continue, that with an incredible script make it a must have for the PS4 and for this console-gen.
